get.description: Returns call log records filtered by parameters specified.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Internal identifier of the RingCentral account. Default value is "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used.

schema.description: Internal identifier of the RingCentral account. Default value is "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used.

parameters.name: extensionNumber
parameters.description:
Short extension number of a user. If specified, returns call log for this particular extension only.

Cannot be combined with `phoneNumber` filter

schema.description:
Short extension number of a user. If specified, returns call log for this particular extension only.

Cannot be combined with `phoneNumber` filter

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction of call records to be included in the result. If omitted, both inbound and outbound calls are returned.

schema.description: The direction of call records to be included in the result. If omitted, both inbound and outbound calls are returned.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of call records to be included in the result. If omitted, all call types are returned.

schema.description: The type of call records to be included in the result. If omitted, all call types are returned.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Defines the level of details for returned call records.

schema.description: Defines the level of details for returned call records.

parameters.name: withRecording
parameters.description:
Deprecated, replaced with `recordingType` filter, still supported for compatibility reasons.
Indicates if only recorded calls should be returned.

If both `withRecording` and `recordingType` parameters are specified, then `withRecording` is ignored

schema.description:
Deprecated, replaced with `recordingType` filter, still supported for compatibility reasons.
Indicates if only recorded calls should be returned.

If both `withRecording` and `recordingType` parameters are specified, then `withRecording` is ignored

parameters.name: recordingType
parameters.description: Indicates that call records with recordings of particular type should be returned. If omitted, then calls with and without recordings are returned.

schema.description: Indicates that call records with recordings of particular type should be returned. If omitted, then calls with and without recordings are returned.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to return call records in ISO 8601 format including timezone, for example `2016-03-10T18:07:52.534Z`.

The default value is `dateTo` minus 24 hours

schema.description:
The beginning of the time range to return call records in ISO 8601 format including timezone, for example `2016-03-10T18:07:52.534Z`.

The default value is `dateTo` minus 24 hours

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to return call records in ISO 8601 format including timezone, for example `2016-03-10T18:07:52.534Z`.

The default value is current time.

schema.description:
The end of the time range to return call records in ISO 8601 format including timezone, for example `2016-03-10T18:07:52.534Z`.

The default value is current time.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Internal identifier of a call session.

schema.description: Internal identifier of a call session.

parameters.name: telephonySessionId
parameters.description: Internal identifier of a telephony session.

schema.description: Internal identifier of a telephony session.

parameters.name: showDeleted
parameters.description: Indicates that deleted calls records should be returned

schema.description: Indicates that deleted calls records should be returned

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
